meta.name: baoyu-post-to-x
meta.description: 自媒体创作者需要在X(Twitter)发布内容时，支持图文、视频、引用推文及Markdown长文发布，通过真实Chrome浏览器绕过反自动化检测，一键完成多格式内容分发，有效规避封号风险。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键把图文视频和长文发布到X，规避封号风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常把图文视频同步到X，担心频繁操作被限流封号。
copy.tagline_en: Publish images, videos and long posts to X in one click, avoiding account bans.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly publish images, videos or long text to X and worry about being flagged or banned.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用真实 Chrome 浏览器把内容发到 X:文字配图、视频、引用推文和 Markdown 长文。默认只生成预览,加 --submit 参数才真正发布。
howto.when: 当你要把文字配图、视频或长文发到 X(Twitter),或要引用某条推文时触发。需要先装好 Chrome 和 bun,首次使用要手动登录 X。

say.text: 把这段文字和 photo.png 发到 X,先给我预览
say.note: 默认只预览,确认后才发布

say.text: 用这条推文链接做引用转发,评论写「说得好」
把 article.md 发布成 X 长文,封面用 cover.jpg
say.note: X 长文需要 Premium 账号

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude posts to X through a real Chrome browser: text with images, video, quote tweets, and long-form Markdown articles. By default it only previews; add --submit to actually publish.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to publish text with images, a video, or a long-form article to X, or quote an existing tweet. Requires Chrome and the bun runtime, with a one-time manual X login.

say_en.text: Post this text with photo.png to X, preview first
say_en.note: Previews by default; posts after you confirm

say_en.text: Quote tweet this link with the comment "Nice point"
Publish article.md as an X long-form article with cover.jpg
